specification: WWCP POI 3: the QI-Digital documents, a proof of concept (libs/WWCP_POI/WWCP_POI3/RoamingNetwork/QIDigital), as example A14 (libs/WWCP_POI/examples/exampleA14.md) published them in one run: test-vectors/runs/csharp-76d3653
description: The papers of the meter of DE*GEF*E2*1 as their issuers signed them: the digital certificates of conformity of the PTB, the digital declaration of conformity of SAALE and the digital calibration certificate of EM-LAB. A vector names its document (file, JSON pointer, JSON patch; or text) and its check: "verify" against the roaming network "network" at "at", "certificate" the declaration against the certificate of conformity "certificate", "cover" the certificate of conformity covering the energy meter of the EVSE "evseId" of "chargingStationOperatorId" as "network" names it at runtime. A refusal while reading the document is a refusal; the other inputs must read. A refusal takes its "control" first, the same check with the documents of the run, against QA as published, at "at", and names its "reason" where both implementations word it alike.

vectors.description: The EU-type examination certificate of the SM-3 (module B), against QA: of the PTB, the notified body 0102 for the MID, valid at AT, for a model of SAALE in revisions and versions it has, signed by the key of the PTB for certificates (ML-DSA-65).
The approval of the quality system of SAALE (module D), against QA: for an energy meter manufacturer of QA, scope MI-003, signed by the key of the PTB for certificates.
The EU declaration of conformity of the SM-3, against QA: signed by the key of SAALE for its models (ES256), each notified body it names one of QA with its number.
The calibration certificate of the meter of DE*GEF*E2*1, against QA: of EM-LAB, signed by its key for certificates, its item the meter as QA names it at runtime.

The declaration against the EU-type examination certificate it names: of the notified body and the module it names it with, under one of its legislations, for its model in all its revisions and versions.
The declaration against the approval of the quality system it names: of the manufacturer of its model, of its kind, with energy meters in its scope.
The EU-type examination certificate covers the meter of DE*GEF*E2*1 as QA names it at runtime: its model, hardware revision and firmware version.
The approval of the quality system covers the meter of DE*GEF*E2*1: an energy meter of SAALE, of MI-003.

The declaration against the EU-type examination certificate, its @id written in lower case: identifications are compared without case (DigitalCertificateOfConformity_Id), the certificate is the one it names.
Another error at Imax, changed after it was signed (example A14, 6a): its signature is not the one of its content.
